name: Shiratori Chizuru
source:
The proprietress of the ryokan “Shizu” who runs the ryokan all by herself since her husband passed away. She looks so young that she is mistaken for a woman in her late twenties.

She has been so busy that she has not been able to meet anyone and has missed the opportunity to remarry, so she has been spending her days without a man in her life.

She has a calm personality, just like the proprietress of an inn. Her husband died a few months ago, and she often looks lonely.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/onsenokami/index.html]official site[/url]]
